comparison.objective: Set snap traps at droppings, square and with trigger ends toward the wall, not commission machinery.
comparison.physical_skill: Trap setting under spring load and spatial orientation versus recessed fastener use, collar tuning, bimanual counterholding, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Traps set square to the wall with trigger ends at the wall; no spec versions or numeric orientation/safe-setting rubric are available. Candidate requires quantified stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and drift checks.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded trap setup tests arming and placement, not damping-response calibration.
